reviews.review: Amazing game. I still play the multiplayer all the time.

5 reasons to buy the game:
1-You will love the action of the game (it looked better than the second game)
2-The decisions you make in the other two games (I played offline for 12 hours, I was about to finish) affect the game well.
3-Character drawings look very nice. (as of 2012)
4-Makes you feel like a real commander.
5-His story is very good.

5 reasons not to buy the game: (Warning: Contains spoilers)
1- Putting a defense task in every action can make you very bored and tired.
2-Ashley Williams is a very annoying character in this game at first and it can overwhelm you.
3- While the second game was too short for me, this game was too long for me.
4-We cannot save the professor. (One of my favorite characters)
5- Our romantic scene with Tali was extremely boring.

My Rating for the Game: 8 out of 10

Fantastic game! Not as great as the Legendary Mass Effect 2. But still solid final entry in the trilogy. Pick up the Legendary Edition and play all 3 games.

So here we are at the end of [b]Mass Effect[/b] (for now and don't you even talk about Andromeda!).
To be honest, it hurts a bit to say goodbye. This game brings closure to many old loved characters while i still would have loved even more of that (Citadel DLC recommended!).  Furthermore your romance routes will propably not disappoint you ;). The action is the best in the trilogy, gameplay is smooth and tactical (also by now you should know the tricks) and in most parts an improvement over ME2.
I remember the "♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥" BioWare got back in 2012 for the ending and i kind of understand that while still liking the ending(s). It brings good closure to the story of the trilogy, satisfies (at least a bit) you doing all sidequests and taking over the savegames from ME1 and 2 and has a debatable yet great twist to it. The end really "forces" you to make a decision you definitely won't like or don't want to make. I still would have loved "more" than what we got!
Over all a great finale to a nearly perfect sci-fi-action-rpg-trilogy! 
Highly recommended to play the sequels first!
8,5/10

Ok, I both endorse and don't endorse this game at the same time. The reason is simple: Game-wise and story-wise, it's great!  It is a wonderful addition to the franchise, the only flaws being the Multiplayer and the Endings.

IF YOU CAN, go and get the MASS EFFECT LEGENDARY EDITION. You'll get remastered and tweaked versions of this and the first two games in the trilogy.  I highly recommend this route, as the entire story line (sans ending) is an amazing tale.

There is one reason to get both this and Legendary Edition, shared with Skyrim and Skyrim Special Edition: it is an amazing game to run through again, adding yet another 100% to your Achievement Hunt total.  Saves SHOULD be compatible between games, as long as you're going from here to Legendary Edition... I think.  Mass Effect 1 and 2 do NOT HAVE Steam Achievements. Mass Effect 3 and Legendary Edition both do.
One of the best stories the world of gaming has to offer.
